answer_1.quote: The goal of the proposed RAG framework is to generate a comprehensive response r i that encompasses all plausible answers A i = {a i,1 , ..., a i,M } of the interpretations Q i = {q i,1 , ..., q i,M } based on the retrieved passages P i = {p i,1 , ..., p i,K }
answer_1.outputs: comprehensive responses covering all plausible interpretations of ambiguous questions

answer_2.quote: For both datasets, following previous studies on ambiguous QA , we mainly adopt F1-based metric. Specifically, for the short-form QA dataset (SituatedQA) we measure F1 based on the precision and recall between the ground-truth answers and the generated responses. Given ASQA is the long-form QA dataset, following , we use Disambig-F1 (D-F1), which assesses the factual accuracy of long-form responses, instead of F1.
